cues: Even though you are conscientious, you still have to be good at saying
"I don't know!”  When you say, "I don't know!" you realize
what you were doing, knowing it was a conscience, was actually the greed!
Once you clearly say, “I don’t know!” you let go of your mindset,
your concepts and everything else. You try letting go again and again,
”Yes, I don’t know you!  I don’t know you either!”
When you try letting of everything you were carrying, you experience what Jesus said,
“Blessed are the poor in spirit." Being poor in spirit means
not keeping much in your mind. It is close to the spirit of non-possession.
You keep things in your mind. You don't keep them anywhere else but in your mind.
Let's suppose you have 100 million now. Do you have 100 million now with your hands?
Where would you have it? In your mind.
"I have 100 million." "I have 10 billion." Do you carry around 10 billion in your hands?
No, you are carrying it around in your mind. "I am a person with 10 billion won!"
For example, "I'm a judge!" "I entered the Blue house” and
“I work for the Blue House!" You are carrying all these notions around in your mind.
Do other people know what you are carrying in your mind?
You are showing them off outwardly just in case they don’t know.
Just in case they don’t know what you have.
Actually, what I have in mind is the most important. So when you come here and say,
"I don't know my name!  I don't know my money!"
“I don’t know the money I have!” “I don’t know about my status.!”
And  “I don’t know anything!” In that state, you experience the non-possessive mind.
The most important thing is letting go of everything in your mind.
Why is it important? What does it mean to let go of the materials?
For instance, try donating 10 billion won or throw it away once.
Then your mind will be filled with the thought of having thrown away 10 billion won.
That is an example of a great possessive mind. You understand that also, right?
The important thing is for the soul to be light
but it carries around a great amount of possessions.
For the soul to be poor, just say,  “I don’t know!”
When you say, “I don’t know!” for 5 minutes, you won’t even know what your name is.
When you just exist because you don't even know what happened five minutes ago
nor about anything else, that’s when you are  in the state of true self and of God.
You can enter that pure spiritual state, the most fundamental of our spirit, soul, and body.
